notes:
{獣医|じゅうい} is the everyday word for a vet, used both of the person and, loosely, of the practice you take an animal to. Formation: {獣|じゅう} 'beast' + {医|い} 'doctor'.

The official term is ⟦{獣医師|じゅういし}→獣医師：30766_juuishi⟧ — that is what appears on the licence and in law, in the same way that ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧ is the formal counterpart of the everyday word for a doctor. In conversation {獣医|じゅうい} is normal.

Where they work:
- ⟦{動物病院|どうぶつびょういん}→動物病院：15638_doubutsubyouin⟧: animal hospital — the usual name for a vet's practice, however small
- {獣医|じゅうい}⟦クリニック→クリニック：08941_kurinikku⟧: veterinary clinic
